The Canvas simulation in this directory is a verbatim port of [stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks), pinned to commit `a0074c16a106f0abc665fe9712ca445f8f98ad8e`. The ported sources are unmodified.

The upstream project is distributed under the MIT License in `LICENSE`. The water is always drawn light on black; for the light theme the host applies the upstream author's CSS filter to the canvas (`filter: invert(1) hue-rotate(180deg)`), see `web/src/style.css`. The shark roster shown on the login page is configured in Personal Settings and stored with the shared appearance settings. Geist Mono 600 is self-hosted as an exact-glyph WOFF2 subset under the SIL Open Font License in `/fonts/geist-mono-OFL.txt`.
